fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior or Sold Post without a disclosed consideration does not receive an inferred price.
Withdrawn Prior or Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale.
Historical or previous rent is not represented as current passing rent.
Seller contributions, stepped rent, gross/net income and holding-over occupancy are kept distinct.
Future indexed rent reviews, options and reversionary events are not treated as current completed facts.
Planning, development, conversion and alternative-use potential remain subject to consents.
Administration, receiver and physical-condition caveats are preserved.
Historical tenancy facts are kept separate from current registry status.
